summary_1line: Sugriva recounts how Bali misinterpreted his actions at the cave, accusing him of betrayal and rejecting his plea for reconciliation.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sugriva kneels with joined palms before the furious Bali in the royal court, while ministers watch as Bali's eyes blaze with anger.
At the dark mouth of the cavern, blood mixed with foam flows outward as Sugriva seals the entrance with a massive rock.
Bali emerges from the cave covered in battle grime, only to see Sugriva seated beneath the royal canopy in Kishkindha.
